conclusion: fixed-vs-random timing dependence reproduced with stable controls
limitations: Repeated deterministic seeds establish reproducibility, not independence.
Correlation does not identify the leaking internal operation.
This host result does not establish Cortex-M33 power/EM leakage or key recovery.
scope: Cross-run reproducibility of class-B elapsed time for the exact same deterministic signing-RNG seeds. Path counters and signature digests must match before timing correlation is reported.
